Meters & Pay Stations

Parking in the business districts of South Orange is regulated by meters, pay by plate, pay stations, or permits. Meter and pay by plate parking is for a set amount of time, at a set rate. An example would be; short term electronic meters on Sloan Street for 50¢ for 30 minute limit.

Enforcement

All meters and pay by plate machines are enforced Monday - Saturday, 8am - 6pm, except the 12 hour meters, which are enforced from 6am- 6pm Monday- Saturday. No enforcement on Sundays and Holidays. 

Prohibited

Meter feeding is prohibited by ordinance and means you may not park longer than the stated time. No overnight parking, between 2-6am is allowed in any parking lot or on any street in South Orange without permission or a permit.
